title: Persona Following Is Not Selective Control: The Neutrality Gap in LLM User Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.35036v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Persona prompting is widely used in LLM user simulation, yet it relies on an untested assumption: specifying a target user attribute should shift target behavior while leaving other fixed attributes unchanged. Across eight black-box and five open-weight models, however, changing a target attribute alone also shifts unspecified non-target choices, such as risk preference shifting color choice. We test whether explicitly specifying non-target attributes restores selective control across 477 held-out synthetic worlds and 200 independent items under unspecified, directional, and neutral states. Assigning a clear non-target direction nearly eliminates cross-attribute shifts. Explicitly declaring no preference, however, still leaves 37.7%-76.3% of held-out worlds and 51%-81% of independent non-target items shifting with the target attribute while preserving target efficacy. translated_title: 人设遵循并非选择性控制：大语言模型用户模拟中的中性差距
translated_abstract: 人设提示被广泛应用于大语言模型（LLM）用户模拟中，但其依赖一个未经检验的假设：指定目标用户属性应当改变目标行为，同时保持其他固定属性不变。然而，在八个黑盒模型和五个开源权重模型上，仅改变目标属性也会使未指定的非目标选择发生变化，例如风险偏好会连带改变颜色选择。我们在477个保留的合成世界和200个独立条目上，于未指定、方向性和中性三种状态下，测试显式指定非目标属性能否恢复选择性控制。结果显示，为非目标属性赋予明确方向几乎消除了跨属性偏移；然而，即使显式声明“无偏好”，仍有37.7%-76.3%的保留合成世界和51%-81%的独立非目标条目随目标属性发生偏移，同时目标属性的有效性得以保持。我们将这种差异称为“中性差距”。
tldr: 该论文发现大语言模型用户模拟中，即使显式声明非目标属性“无偏好”，非目标行为仍会随目标人设属性发生偏移（即“中性差距”），证明人设遵循并不等于选择性控制。
en_tdlr: Even when LLM user simulators are explicitly told there is no preference on non-target attributes, non-target behaviors still shift with the target persona attribute (the "neutrality gap"), showing that persona following is not selective control.
